title: Augustana University to Celebrate 103rd Homecoming,  Viking Bold Campaign Success
summary_en: Augustana University is celebrating its 103rd homecoming during Viking Days 2026, beginning on Monday, Oct. 19, through Sunday, Oct. 25. Generations of  Vikings will unite to celebrate all things blue and gold — a beloved tradition that officially became known as "Viking Days" in 1929.
